title: 第9章 敛气术第10章 玄身不坏肉体结丹
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 拿到指间陀螺者，无不欢喜，此刻都在询问价格。
钱朵朵张口便道：“10枚下品灵石一个，诸位莫要嫌贵，此物之精巧，绝非刀剑能比。而且，整个宗门现在就只有眼下这些，不会再多出哪怕一件来。其珍贵程度，自不必我说。”
钱朵朵言语间是满满的自豪与骄傲，听得李牧火差点都有些信了，莫非这指间陀螺真的能辅助修行不成？
不过，10枚下品灵石的定价，着实让他心里“咯噔”了一下，这丫头是真敢要啊。
要知道，仅材料成本，算上那一丝丝精铁的价值，最多也就两个灵币而已，相当于五分之一块灵石。
而一开始，他其实是想定价2枚下品灵石的，没想到钱朵朵直接给他翻了五倍。
就在李牧火觉得这些人定会还价或者犹豫斟酌时。
“我买了。”
“我也买了。”
一群人争抢付钱，甚至还有人围上来道：“姑娘，这指间陀螺啥时候还有？”
“姑娘，此物可以预订吗？”
钱朵朵则看向李牧火，后者犹豫了一下，终于开口道：“可以。”
片刻后。
李牧火抱着灵石袋子，和钱朵朵好不容易摆脱询问的人群，这才寻了处相对安静之地。
李牧火满脸唏嘘道：“师妹，你要价是不是太贵了？”
钱朵朵则一副理所当然道：“我说的都是实话，我也经常玩指间陀螺，它确实能缓解我的压力。这种功效，在修行中是极为罕见的，所以10枚下品灵石一点儿都不贵，我甚至还觉得便宜了呢。而且，此物一定会有人仿制的，现在不卖贵些，以后可能就轮不到我们了。”
李牧火咋舌，心说这丫头思虑得还挺周全。
当然了，李牧火并没有责怪钱朵朵的意思，毕竟他又不是圣人，怎会嫌身上的灵石太多了？
说到灵石，李牧火当即分出一袋子灵石递给钱朵朵。今日所有的东西一共卖了290枚下品灵石，主要都是钱朵朵的功劳，他自然不会独享。
“师兄，你这是干什么？”
“我本来觉得今天能卖四五十灵石就不错了，多出来都是你的功劳，我自然不能让你白忙活。”
钱朵朵当即小脸一冷，嘴巴一撇：“如此见外，你是把我当成卖东西的伙计了？”
李牧火当即暗道不好，心念一转道：“我当然没这么觉得，但你是我亲师妹，我送你点灵石怎么了？”
“这还差不多。”
钱朵朵喜滋滋地收下了那一袋子灵石，但转头又抓回给李牧火不少，最终只留下了四五十块的样子。
“师兄，既然东西卖了，我也要去买东西了，你要一起吗？”
钱朵朵邀请道。
“我就不了，我转一下看看有没有矿材，然后得去藏书楼看看有没有炼器方面的书。”
“又是炼器，你整天脑子里除了炼器就没别的了吗？”
钱朵朵颇为无语地说道。
“没有。”
李牧火还认真思考了一下，开玩笑，哪还有比炼器更有意思的事情了？
“再见。”
钱朵朵跺了跺脚，便气鼓鼓地走进了赶集的人群。
李牧火也没太在意，也自顾逛起了集市，各种琳琅满目的修行资源，大半他都不认识，只看个新鲜。
直至他路过一个卖灵草的摊位，那些灵草自然没法吸引他的注意力，但灵草旁边摆着的一块婴儿脑袋大小青黑幽亮的铁块，引起了他的注意。
content_en:
Those who got the finger spinner were all happy and were asking about the price.
Qian Duoduo opened his mouth and said: "Ten low-grade spiritual stones for one, don't be too expensive. The exquisiteness of this thing is beyond the comparison of swords. Moreover, the entire sect only has these now, and there will not be even one more. I don't need to say how precious it is."
Qian Duoduo's words were full of pride and arrogance, which made Li Muhuo almost believe it. Could it be that this finger spinning top can really assist in spiritual practice?
However, the price of 10 low-grade spirit stones really made him feel a little "thumped" in his heart. This girl really dared to ask for it.
You know, the material cost alone, including the value of the fine iron, is only two spirit coins at most, which is equivalent to one-fifth of a spirit stone.
At the beginning, he actually wanted to price two low-grade spiritual stones, but Qian Duoduo paid him five times the price.
Just when Li Muhuo felt that these people would definitely make a counteroffer or hesitate.
"I bought it."
"I bought it too."
A group of people scrambled to pay, and some even came around and said, "Girl, when will this finger spinning top be available again?"
"Girl, can this be reserved?"
Qian Duoduo looked at Li Muhuo, who hesitated for a moment and finally said, "Okay."
After a while.
Holding the bag of spirit stones, Li Muhuo and Qian Duoduo managed to get away from the questioning crowd and found a relatively quiet place.
Li Muhuo said with a sigh on his face: "Junior sister, is the price you are asking for too expensive?"
Qian Duoduo said matter-of-factly: "I'm telling the truth. I often play with finger spinning tops. It really relieves my stress. This kind of effect is extremely rare in practice, so 10 low-grade spiritual stones are not expensive at all. I even think they are cheap. Moreover, there will definitely be someone imitating this thing. If it is not sold more expensively now, it may not be our turn in the future."
Li Muhuo was speechless, thinking that this girl was quite thoughtful.
Of course, Li Muhuo didn't mean to blame Qian Duoduo. After all, he was not a saint, so how could he think he had too many spiritual stones?
Speaking of spirit stones, Li Muhuo immediately handed out a bag of spirit stones and handed them to Qian Duoduo. Today, a total of 290 low-grade spiritual stones were sold for all the items, which was mainly due to Qian Duoduo. Naturally, he would not keep it to himself.
"Brother, what are you doing?"
"I originally thought it would be good if I could sell forty or fifty spirit stones today. The extra money is all thanks to you. Naturally, I can't let your work go in vain."
Qian Duoduo's face immediately turned cold and her mouth curled up: "You are so outrageous, do you think I am a salesman?"
Li Muhuo immediately thought to himself that it was not good, and then changed his mind and said: "Of course I don't think so, but you are my biological junior sister, what's wrong if I give you some spiritual stones?"
"That's pretty much it."
Qian Duoduo happily accepted the bag of spirit stones, but then turned around and grabbed them back to anger Li Mu, leaving only forty or fifty yuan in the end.
"Brother, since the things are sold, I have to go shopping. Do you want to come with me?"
Qian Duoduo invited.
"I won't. I'll look around to see if there are any mineral materials. Then I have to go to the library to see if there are any books on weapon refining."
"It's weapon refining again. Is there nothing else on your mind other than weapon refining all day long?"
Qian Duoduo said quite speechlessly.
"No."
Li Muhuo also thought about it seriously, joking, what could be more interesting than refining weapons?
"Goodbye."
Qian Duoduo stamped her feet and angrily walked into the crowd at the market.
Li Muhuo didn't pay too much attention, and went to the market by himself. He didn't recognize most of the various dazzling cultivation resources, and just took a look at what was new.
Until he passed by a stall selling spiritual herbs, those spiritual herbs naturally failed to attract his attention, but a bright green and black iron block the size of a baby's head placed next to the spiritual herbs caught his attention.
